title: 目標達成の後に・邁進！

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: We seem to be gaining quite positive results lately.
choice_data_list: You're getting used to the races too.
You're getting used to the races too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes. I owe that to the experience I acquire each time I hit the course.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: And next year, I will be able to attempt the Classics, so…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: As a stayer, I absolutely want to win the Kikuka Sho and its prelude, the Kobe Shimbun Hai.
choice_data_list: We'll need to keep focused then!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes. I won't be lax in my training. I shall maintain a proper condition to achieve success in the Classics!
